"""design_800E 모델링 준비: 코호트, 결과, 특징 테이블과 분할 배정을 만든다 (학습 없음)."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D = WS / "data"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
design = json.loads((WS / "design_800E.json").read_text())

p = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
orders = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])
labs = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])

# tp = 퇴원 시각 + 0h
a = a.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
a["tp"] = a["discharge_time"]

# 결과: 같은 환자의 다음 입원이 (tp, tp+30d] 안에 시작
a["next_admit"] = a.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
gap = a["next_admit"] - a["tp"]
a["readmit_30d"] = ((gap > pd.Timedelta(0)) & (gap <= pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)
data_end = a["admit_time"].max()
a["followup_complete"] = (a["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30)) <= data_end

# 코호트
a = a.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left")
n0 = len(a)
a = a[a["age"] >= 18]
n_adult = len(a)
a = a[a["discharge_status"] != "died"].copy()
n_final = len(a)

# 특징
a["n_prior_adm"] = a.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()  # 같은 환자의 이전 입원 수 (died 제외 전 기준 아님 주의: 아래에서 재계산)
a_all = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time"]).sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"])
a_all["n_prior_adm"] = a_all.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()
a["n_prior_adm"] = a["admission_id"].map(a_all.set_index("admission_id")["n_prior_adm"])
a["los_h"] = (a["discharge_time"] - a["admit_time"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600  # length_of_stay_h 열이 없어 유도

win = a[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]]

def in_window(df, tcol):
    m = df.merge(win, on="admission_id")
    return m[(m[tcol] >= m["admit_time"]) & (m[tcol] <= m["tp"])]

dial = in_window(orders[orders["order_type"] == "dialysis_order"], "order_time")
a["dialysis_ordered"] = a["admission_id"].isin(dial["admission_id"]).astype(int)

lw = in_window(labs, "report_time")
cr = lw[lw["test"] == "creatinine"].sort_values("report_time").groupby("admission_id")["value"].last()
hgb = lw[lw["test"] == "hemoglobin"].groupby("admission_id")["value"].min()
a["cr_last"] = a["admission_id"].map(cr)
a["hgb_min"] = a["admission_id"].map(hgb)

# 진단: 설계에 scope/시점이 없어 '현재 입원'으로 잠정 한정 (보고서 참조)
a["n_dx"] = a["admission_id"].map(dx.groupby("admission_id").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)
for name, code in [("dx_chf", "I50"), ("dx_ckd", "N18")]:
    ids = dx.loc[dx["icd_code"].str.startswith(code), "admission_id"]
    a[name] = a["admission_id"].isin(ids).astype(int)

feat_names = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]

# 분할: family_id 결측이 많아 결측이면 patient_id로 대체한 그룹 키 사용 (잠정, 보고서 참조)
a["split_group"] = a["family_id"].fillna("PAT_" + a["patient_id"])
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
groups = np.array(sorted(a["split_group"].unique()))
rng.shuffle(groups)
n_test = int(round(len(groups) * design["split"]["test_fraction"]))
test_groups = set(groups[:n_test])
a["split"] = np.where(a["split_group"].isin(test_groups), "test", "train")

cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "tp", "followup_complete", "readmit_30d"] + feat_names
a[cols].to_csv(OUT / "analysis_table.csv", index=False)

summary = {
    "n_admissions": n0, "after_adult": n_adult, "after_exclude_died": n_final,
    "outcome_rate": round(a["readmit_30d"].mean(), 4),
    "n_followup_incomplete": int((~a["followup_complete"]).sum()),
    "split_counts": a["split"].value_counts().to_dict(),
    "split_outcome_rate": a.groupby("split")["readmit_30d"].mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "missing_rate": a[feat_names].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "family_id_missing_rate_patients": round(p["family_id"].isna().mean(), 4),
}
(OUT / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
E
